title: [Feedback]: Forced org-wide task visibility is frustrating
summary: ## Feedback Not every task should be shared with or visible to the whole team by default. While the collaborative features are often helpful, they're not always necessary, even if other HumanLayer features are still needed. Smaller tasks, experiments, etc., don't need to be on everyone's radar. On a large team with a lot going on, this can create a lot of noise and clutter on the tasks page. Default visibility can also create the feeling of "being watched," which isn't something all teams do.

title: Download issue workaround.
summary: Workaround for the broken XyGrib server — standalone GRIB downloader For anyone still affected by the XyGrib GRIB server being down or broken: I’ve written a standalone downloader that bypasses the server entirely and prepares files XyGrib can actually open. Repo: https://github.com/Mike101202/marine-grib-downloader grib_downloader.sh v2.23 fetches directly from NOAA/NOMADS, HYCOM, DWD, and ECMWF, then does the conversion locally. It does not depend on the XyGrib server. What it handles: GFS, GFS-Wave, RTOFS, HYCOM, ECMWF, ICON Converts HYCOM/RTOFS NetCDF currents to XyGrib-readable GRIB1: edition=1, centre=kwbc(7), subCentre=0, table2Version=2, indicatorOfParameter=49 (U) / 50 (V), typeOfLevel=surface, level=0, gridType=regular_ll, packingType=grid_simple Fixes the fill-value issue that breaks conversion: RTOFS uses a -9e33 finite sentinel, HYCOM uses IEEE NaN. Both are sanitized before cdo/GRIB1 packing so real current values don’t collapse to zero. Writes separate output folders: Xygrib/ — wind/wave GRIB2 plus the standalone GRIB1 currents companion (currents are not merged into the wind/wave file) OpenCPN/ — merged GRIB2 with currents included, for OpenCPN/qtVlm Includes an installer (install_grib_downloader.sh) that checks and installs the required tools: cdo, eccodes, wgrib2, xarray, netCDF4, ecmwf-opendata Built specifically to only download the area and time window you ask for — it uses server-side subsetting, so it stays well within NOMADS/HYCOM rate limits. No full global downloads. Tested on Debian/Ubuntu The part most relevant to XyGrib is convert_nc_to_xygrib_grib1(). It reproduces the GRIB1 identity found in working Saildocs RTOFS files, which is what XyGrib needs for currents. If the maintainers want to integrate or adapt this, I’m happy to turn it into a PR. Repo: https://github.com/Mike101202/marine-grib-downloader
